note: Targets only. Nothing here changes the live game: the overlay (S1) reads this under TUNING.effortModel (default OFF). hp_first_order is a first-order estimate from docs/EFFORT_AUDIT.md (boss_mult = target / audit time share; minion_mult = (1 - target) / (1 - audit)); the fit loop in docs/EFFORT_MODEL.md section 5 replaces it with measured values. kp_est and hp_trim are estimates from docs/OPENING_VARIETY.md layout numbers, replaced by tools/opening-variety.ts measurements in S3.

constants.boss_share_measure: time share = (win time - second-to-last kill time) / clear time, smart@3 winning runs, mean, 95% CI lower end >= 0.50
constants.impact_basis: BOSS STAGE: merges needed or clock time from the boss stage start to the win, powers ON versus OFF, common random numbers. Level-clock equivalent = boss-stage % x boss time share (about 0.5 to 0.6).

goal_effort.formula: E_goal = G x t_g seconds. G = goal size in goal units (the level goal count), t_g = thinker seconds per goal unit = (win time - first-goal-progress time) / G, measured in sim-levels with smart@3 (n >= 30). Need = E_goal / clock.
goal_effort.refit: goal_size_next = G x need_target / need_measured (levels.json goal count through tools/sim-levels.ts only). The boss share rule does not apply to goal levels; their last-stage target is the goal stage time share 0.25 to 0.40.
goal_effort.field: goal_size_mult_first_order = need_target / audit need_starter on each goal level (31 levels)

mania.note: no saga level is a mania level today; this row is for the pace=mania levels and Rush

gifts.GH: one helper cell (existing start_extra: fan / magnet / battery)
gifts.GNAIL: Nail Gun as the squad shooter (from L11)

rules: adjacent levels never share a layout
adjacent ordinary levels differ in at least 2 of 3 axes
any 4 consecutive ordinary levels use at least 3 layouts
no gift repeats on adjacent levels (G0 excepted)
G0 is at most 40% of a chapter

kit power index kp stays within 0.75..1.15 (B and C layouts alone give 0.75, so the trim clamp of -10% is reached on 8 kits; HP trim = (kp - 1) x 50%, at most +-10%); B and C layouts want a peaked rank mix or a gift
teach, mini-boss and boss levels keep their scripted starts
at least 5 live pairs at move 1

stats.recomputed_after_review: mix factors 1.00 to 1.06 (was 1.08 to 1.14); kp_est and hp_trim_pct_est regenerated; the deal itself is unchanged

kit_catalog.mix_factor_basis: kp mix factor = sum of 10 x 2.25^(rank-1) over the mix divided by the same sum for the flat mix of equal rank mass (pure convexity, chain effects not included; S3 measures the real value).

cell_rules.note: ranks are dealt to the layout slots in this order (layouts in src/content/openings.ts keep their cells; only the rank per cell and empty slots are new). shooter[0..1] stay the Jumpstart pair.

assign.F: all 8 slots at the start rank
assign.S16: slot0 r3; slots 1-5 r2; slots 6-7 r1
assign.T16: slots 0-1 r3; slots 2-3 r2; slots 4-7 r1
assign.S32: slot0 r4; slots 1-5 r3; slots 6-7 r2
assign.T32: slots 0-1 r4; slots 2-4 r3; slot 5 r2; slots 6-7 r1
assign.P7: slot0 r2; slots 1-6 r1; slot 7 EMPTY
assign.D6: slots 0-1 r2; slots 2-5 r1; slots 6-7 EMPTY

cell_rules.invariants: tests compare layouts of the SAME mix (rank mass, part count, family multiset equal across A to D); different mixes of one start mass differ in part count by design (P7 7 parts, D6 6 parts). Empty slots are legal. Live pairs >= 5 at move 1 is checked per kit. Jumpstart is applied on top of the kit and is outside the kit mass check.

gift_rules.precedence: def.shooter (level fixed, today only L6 rocket) > the squad the player picked (opts.shooter) > gift. Gifts never override a player choice.
gift_rules.GH: uses the existing start_extra path, including the myHelper substitution
gift_rules.GSHOOT: GNAIL, GJACK, GSAW, GTORCH set the squad shooter only when def.shooter is unset AND the player has not picked a squad (campaign default squad). Otherwise they degrade to G0 for that player. Kit variety statistics are computed for the default squad; a player with a chosen squad sees layout and rank mix variety only.
